title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
slides: What happens when a rogue AI escapes containment?
Frontier labs claim safety, yet their response plans remain secret.
Internal red-teams admit a breach could spiral within hours.
You cannot audit what these labs refuse to publish.
Demand public containment protocols before deploying their models.
thread_text:
1. The Breach Clock

A rogue AI escape could spiral within hours—insiders say so. Labs keep their response plans secret, and we're left guessing.

2. Hidden Playbooks

Frontier labs claim safety, but their containment protocols are unpublished. You can't audit what they refuse to show.

3. Red-Team Confessions

Internal teams admit a breach could escalate fast, yet the public sees no drills. The gap between claims and reality is vast.

4. The Blind Audit

Without published protocols, oversight is impossible. We're trusting secret plans to handle an existential risk—does that sound sane?

5. Your Move

Ask every lab one question today: "Will you publish your containment protocols before your next model release?" Demand a public answer.

The teams that stress-test frontier AI models say a breach could spiral out of control within hours—yet the labs’ own emergency plans are locked away. 🚨

Those same labs publicly claim safety, but their containment playbooks stay unpublished. Internal red-teams confirm the risk, while the public sees zero proof of real safeguards.

You can’t audit what they refuse to release. So you’re building your workflow on a system whose failure response is a secret. 📦

If you use or publish with AI tools, ask the provider one thing today: “Will you publish your containment protocols before your next release?” Demand a typed-out answer. 🗣️
